answer: Because the timing is written down against the terrace challenge, the ivory audit can replay the garden history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 77 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 339 aliases cost 238 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
